description: Full UK buy-to-let analysis for a purchase price and monthly rent: gross and true net yield after service charge, ground rent, agent fees, repairs, voids and mortgage interest, Section 24 tax, monthly cashflow before and after tax, break-even mortgage rate, a 0 to 100 deal score, and stress scenarios such as a rate shock, a recession and extended voids. Agent fee, repairs and voids the user has not given take standard assumptions, listed in assumptions_applied. Returns a link that opens the same deal in the calculator.

agent_fee_percentage.description: Letting agent fee as a percentage of rent. Pass 0 if the landlord self-manages; omitted means the standard 12%.

agent_fee_vat_applicable.description: Whether VAT at 20% is added to the agent fee.

corporation_tax_rate.description: Corporation tax rate percentage, used for company ownership.

current_market_value.description: Current market value in GBP, if yields should be based on value rather than purchase price.

mortgage_balance.description: Mortgage amount borrowed in GBP. Omit or 0 for a cash purchase.

mortgage_rate.description: Annual mortgage interest rate as a percentage, for example 4.5.

ownership_type.description: Held personally (Section 24 applies) or through a limited company.

repairs_percentage.description: Repairs and maintenance allowance as a percentage of rent. Omitted means the standard 5%.

service_charge_monthly.description: Monthly service charge in GBP (leasehold flats).

tax_band.description: The landlord's income tax band: basic (20%), higher (40%) or additional (45%).

utilities_monthly.description: Monthly utilities paid by the landlord in GBP.

valuation_basis.description: Base yields on the purchase price or the current market value.

void_months_per_year.description: Expected empty months per year. Omitted means the standard 1 month.

name: analyse_buy_to_let_deal
title: Analyse a buy-to-let deal
